This agreement is entered into effect as of <effDate>, between <party1> as Seller and <party2> as Buyer.

1. Payment and Delivery
1.1 The Seller shall sell <qnt> of <qlt> quality meat ("Goods") to the Buyer.
1.2 Title in the Goods shall not pass to the Buyer until payment in full has been made.
1.3 The Seller shall deliver the Goods to the Buyer at its warehouse within <delDueDateDays> days of the effective date.
1.4 The Buyer shall pay <amt> in <curr> to the Seller within <payDueDateDays> days of delivery.
1.5 In the event of late payment, the Buyer shall pay a late fee of <interestRate> of the amount owed. The Seller may suspend performance of all of its delivery obligations until payment of all amounts owed has been received in full.
1.6 Should the Buyer pay all outstanding amounts while the Seller's obligations are suspended, the Buyer shall be entitled to request resumption of delivery.

2. Termination
2.1 The Buyer may terminate this agreement in the event that the Seller fails to deliver the Goods.
